evidence: Per view, which of its two g_viewRecords (view * 2 + this) is in use: View_GetActiveCameraMode/Flags and VIEW_MODE_RECORD index with it; reset to 0 for each view.
Per view record index, the CameraSpot it uses (set with the chosen spot, read as g_pCameraSpots[g_viewCameraSpot[record->index]]).
Replay files loaded for playback (validated by size, set up with Replay_SetupPointers and counted in g_replayLevelState.bufferCount); slots 8..15 of g_replaySlots point at them; freed unless pending.
Per weather type, the divisor of the draw distance that gives the fog end (0 = no fog limit; 0.4/0.5/0.6 for the two foggy groups), StageLights_SetWeatherFogDistance.
Per view, the far plane View_SetPlayerProjection passes to CGraphics::SetProjection (raised to 0x960000 on the championship final stage); set by View_SetFarPlane.
Per view, CameraRecord::nearPlane of the blended camera state (View_BlendCameraStates), the near plane passed to CGraphics::SetProjection.
Per view, CameraRecord::zoom of the blended state; View_SetPlayerProjection scales both field-of-view terms by it.
Per view record, car position plus the smoothed lead (View_UpdateTracksideAimTarget), or the start of the spot's range; the target of g_tracksideAims.
Per view record, the point the following trackside camera looks at (View_BuildTracksideCameraMatrix); stepped towards g_tracksideAimTargets.
Set once the aim reaches its target; the aim then copies the target (View_StepTracksideAim).
Smoothed (0.9/0.1) View_BuildTracksideAimLead vector added to the car position for the aim target.
Zoom target blended between CameraSpot::zoom and zoomAtRange by the car's distance over the range.
Zoom stepped towards g_tracksideZoomTargets; becomes CameraRecord::zoom (times 0xa000) when following.
0..1.0 fraction of (trackEnd - position) the camera is moved along (times 2) when the spot's dollyStep > 0.
Set once the car is within the spot's range: the camera turns to the aim instead of the spot's fixed basis.
Camera-to-car distance; below CameraSpot::shakeRange the camera shakes, and it selects aimStep/zoomStep [0] or [1].
Smoothed CameraSpot::dollyStep passed to View_AdvanceTracksideDolly.
Smoothed CameraSpot::zoomStep[] passed to View_StepTracksideZoom.
Smoothed CameraSpot::aimStep[] passed to View_StepTracksideAim.
Per view record, the CameraRecord::carLift of the car-mounted views (View_PositionFromCarProfile): 1.0 or 0 from the camera switch handlers (CarCamera_*).
Per player, the chase camera pitch (ChaseCamera_SetPitch); entries 2/3 the distance-reduced copy ChaseCamera_BuildMatrix rotates the view by.
Per player, ChaseCameraSettings::lag; ChaseCamera_Update eases the view by timeStep / lag (14.0 for the fixed modes).
Entries 0/1: each player's chase camera offset (ChaseCamera_SetOffset/GetOffset); 2..5: each view record's chase up vector.
Entries 0/1: the view offset derived from the chase offset (ChaseCamera_GetViewOffset in mode 4); 2..5: each view record's chase forward vector.
Lag read from camera menu slider 2 (InRaceMenu_ReadCameraOffsetSliders), applied with ChaseCamera_SetLag and stored as the driver's lag.
Pitch read from camera menu slider 3, eased in and applied with ChaseCamera_SetPitch, stored as the driver's pitch.
ChaseCamera_GetLag when the camera menu opens; restored on cancel.
ChaseCamera_GetPitch when the camera menu opens; restored on cancel.
ChaseCamera_GetLag each frame of the in-race step while the camera menu is up.
ChaseCamera_GetOffset each frame; the menu offset is moved from it by a tenth of the difference.
ChaseCamera_GetPitch each frame; the menu pitch is moved from it by a tenth of the difference.
Menu lag minus the current lag (computed, not used further).
Menu height minus the current one; a tenth of it is applied per frame.
Menu pitch minus the current one; a tenth of it is applied per frame.
Menu distance minus the current one; a tenth of it is applied per frame.
strcpy'd from Network_GetSessionNamePointer / CGameInfo::GetSessionName, passed to Session_SetName and CGameInfo::SetSessionName.
strcpy'd from the session password, passed to Session_SetPassword and as lpszPasswordA by EnumerateNetworkSessionsWithUserData; 20 bytes (0x818f0c is a separate global).
Only store: CMain::GetFrameDelta() when FrontendNetwork_HandleHostMessage applies a setup packet.
strcpy'd from rallyStageRecordTimes[stage].ident (default "jml"); GameMenu_DrawStageWinner prints it as the winner outside arcade.
Only store: rallyStageRecordTimes[stage] time bits when the stage results menus are set up.
Set to the split index by the sender of type-8 split time messages (NetRace_SendSplitTime), -1 on reset.
Set to the index by the sender of type-9 stage time messages (NetRace_SendStageTime), -1 on reset.
Set to the 370 16-byte node records after the AI networks' activation buffer (StageTiming_RelocateCarRecordRoutePoints gets the data after them); read per route node for its key and wall clearances.
Graphics_UpdateFrameStatistics stores 1000 / the frame time in ms; printed with the fps format by the debug overlays and turned into the stage effects' time step by Physics_UpdateRateHold.
Stored with the same 1000 / frame time as g_frameRate in Graphics_UpdateFrameStatistics; no reader found.
Eight CollisionBox records indexed by car order or Car::index; cleared at each collision frame, built from car body axes/position/corners and returned by Collision_GetCarBox.
Only store: the first mesh collision record height in Collision_SetObjectSphere (0x487e00); no readers found.
